propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack local Rebar clone, Gerrit access, or tracker worktree despite having GitHub connector and repository visibility, requiring documented safe workflows and fallback mechanisms.
Native ticket creation is impossible only when both tracker-worktree access AND network/remote binary availability fail; other capability gaps do not trigger the fallback.

Fallback ticket payload must conform to export.schema.json required fields (schema_version: 1, agent-generated UUID4 ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status: open) plus description with Acceptance Criteria and optional parent_id, which becomes importable NDJSON without hand-transcription.

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path for NDJSON payloads; it assigns fresh local ids/HLC timestamps, preserves provenance via source_id, is idempotent, and silently skips malformed records (missing ticket_id/ticket_type) with no warning or counter increment in dry-run mode.

Documentation must prohibit raw event-file injection, GitHub Contents API writes to tickets branch, and GitHub Issues as tracker substitutes, and must require search-before-create and append-only-event respect when tracker is accessible.

A lightweight test must validate that AGENTS.md links to a new ChatGPT-specific guide, the guide prohibits GitHub Issues substitution and raw event writes, names rebar import as the sole exceptional path, and fallback payload field list matches export.schema.json's required array.
